_about: Factions and reputation, WoW style. Reputation is earned per faction from quest rewards (`reward.reputation` in quests.json) and from activities in its area, such as killing enemies (`reputation` on an enemy type in enemies.json). `standings` are the named tiers, lowest first, each from `min` points; `discount` is percent off at that faction's vendors (shops with a `faction`). Reputation-gated items and areas will use these tiers later.

factions.name: The Road Wardens
factions.description: The few who still keep the Fallen Road open: Mara at her forge, the watch that was, and anyone who clears the dead from the way.

factions.name: Folk of the Mere
factions.description: Old Tam and the families who fish the Stillwater Mere and trap the woods around it.
